discourse.excerpt: Only one thing is steady. That is love, love, love. Love is God. Live in love.
discourse.theme: Love is God — live in love; it alone is steady, present everywhere, and able to alleviate all suffering.
discourse.title: Love Is God; Live In Love

reflection: Swami says only one thing is steady — love, love, love — and love is God. Today, let love be the undercurrent of everything you do: one quiet kindness, done with no audience and expecting nothing back. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 40, 15 Dec 2007)
seva_nudge: Do one small act of love with no audience today — a quiet kindness for someone who will never know it was you.

video.title: The Love That Lord Krishna Came to Teach | Sathya Sai Baba Discourse on Sep 2, 1991
